concept: A tide table made physical: flat sea-green blocks that wipe left-to-right like a rising waterline, with one amber marker (the Moon's influence) tracked from word to diagram to number.

narrativeArc.beginning: State the surprise: two tides, not one.
narrativeArc.middle: Show why with the Earth-Moon bulge diagram.
narrativeArc.end: Land the number and the line that sets the clock.
narrativeArc.viewerTakeaway: The Moon raises two bulges; a place meets one roughly every 12.4 hours.

typography.hierarchy: display 220/190/150 px > body 40 px; one display block per scene, labels only in the diagram scene
typography.pairingReason: A heavy grotesque for the mass of water, a neutral sans for labels so the diagram reads as data.

designSystem.accentRule: Amber appears on exactly one key word or mark per scene (TWO, the Moon, the ground of the number scene, MOON) and nowhere else.

background.notes: flat colour fields; grounds alternate teal / deep teal / amber / teal so each wipe is visible; no gradients

composition.textDensity: max 11 words per scene; at least 0.5s + 0.3s per word reading time

transitionLanguage.primary: left-to-right clip wipe of the incoming scene's ground (15 frames, move ease)
transitionLanguage.secondary: none — one transition keeps the film calm
transitionLanguage.rule: The wipe travels along the reading axis and is the rising waterline; the incoming scene starts 0.5s before the outgoing scene's logical end.

pacing.rhythm: 3.0s / 4.0s / 3.0s / 2.0s — the diagram scene gets the most time because it carries the explanation

designSystem.densityReason: Deliberate flat editorial contrast example: typography and one drawn diagram per film, no persistent world.

illustration: Earth/Moon/bulge diagram drawn as inline SVG

consistencyRules: Every scene has a different ground colour from the previous one, drawn from the 5-colour palette only.
All text is left-aligned to the 96px margin or to a diagram anchor; nothing is centred.
Amber covers at most one word or mark per scene, except the number scene where it is the ground.
Hero move is always a masked reveal, a draw, or a counter — no scale-bounces on text.
Scene transitions are always the left-to-right wipe.
antiPatterns: No dark navy void with floating elements
No glow, bloom or particle decoration
No centred headline over a gradient
No stock ocean clip-art; the wave is a single drawn stroke with exactly two crests
No text that keeps drifting after it lands
